name: dhancha — the domain spine for FAKIR
description: The domain-invariant skeleton every FAKIR domain is built on: ten invariants, five extracted primitives, a machine-readable domain descriptor, a validator, a cross-domain vocabulary leak check, a correlation graph, the collaborator domain registry with per-domain dockerised lab kits and Holy Grail lab pattern, and PANINI cycler configuration so the work can be done by any model. Emits CycloneDX (ECMA-424), Development Containers, RO-Crate and UCUM rather than inventing equivalents.
